leadText:

plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the sixth season of , Pokémon: Advanced, in and ( ).

In Region 1 releases, the episodes are ordered and separated according to VIZ Media season (which correspond to opening themes), rather than by standard seasons (in the same way as on Pokémon.com).

==Single releases==
Single releases of the series were released by Viz Video and Ventura Distribution in 2004 and 2005 on both VHS and DVD format. However, each DVD volume contains five sequential episodes (the last two listed as "bonus episodes"), while the VHS volumes only contain the first three episodes of their corresponding DVD volume. The DVD volumes contain the entire season between them, but the VHS volumes are missing the episodes that the DVDs label "bonus episodes." Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===DVD===
 

==Boxed sets==
Two Pokémon: Advanced DVD box sets were released by VIZ Media in 2005 and 2006, containing the whole season between them. There are two boxed sets each containing three DVD cases with one disc each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Volume 1===
 
Pokémon: Advanced - Volume 1 was released by VIZ Media on October 25, 2005. It contains three discs with 20 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMABS1.

This box set includes two bonus videos: "Pokémon Trading Card Game: Rise to the Top" and "The Power of Pokémon". "Pokémon Trading Card Game: Rise to the Top" is a short promotional video celebrating the , while "The Power of Pokémon" shows footage of the 2004 World Championships set to a song .

 

===Volume 2===
 
Pokémon: Advanced - Volume 2 was released by VIZ Media on August 22, 2006. It contains three discs with 20 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMABS2.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon: Advanced - The Complete Collection was released on May 16, 2017 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains five discs with 40 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000072675. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover. Optional English closed captioning is included.
